caption: The drawing depicts a square piece of beige or off-white fabric, likely a handkerchief or similar textile, shown laid flat against a plain, light-colored background. The lower right edge and corner of the fabric are adorned with detailed embroidery featuring small flowers, leaves, and fern motifs, as well as a scalloped border with circular patterns aligning the edge. The floral embroidery is concentrated in the bottom right corner and becomes sparser towards the center. The texture of the fabric is rendered with fine lines suggesting a sheer and delicate quality. In the bottom right area of the background, the name "E. GAUSSER" is visible, suggesting the artist’s signature.
